claimed_purpose.text: Omni Memory acts as a middleware proxy between a chat bot and the LLM, automatically injecting and extracting memory on every turn.
An agent service that provides long-term memory capability for LLMs, compatible with OpenAI API format.
API proxy service that gives LLMs long-term memory, sitting between the application and the LLM

mechanisms.text: Curated memory items are persisted to a JSON file (memories.json) on disk, not a raw message log. Each item has an id, content, created_at, updated_at, source, and metadata field.
Two injection modes: full injection (all memories injected into system prompt) and RAG injection (intelligently filters memories relevant to the current conversation).
In external mode, a separate model summarizes the conversation and generates memory operations every N turns (configurable via summary_interval).
Storage is initialised from a data directory at startup via MemoryStorage; a MemoryManager wraps it with memory settings
Memory store is a single shared file (data/memories.json); no per-user or per-session isolation is described
Memory extraction skips reasoning_content (chain-of-thought) and only processes final content

ledger.claim: omemo is an agent proxy service that provides long-term memory for LLMs by intercepting OpenAI-compatible API calls.
ledger.quote: 一个为 LLM 提供长期记忆能力的代理服务。兼容 OpenAI API 格式，可无缝接入任何支持 OpenAI API 的应用。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory store is curated facts, not a full conversation log; each record has id, content, timestamps, and source field.
ledger.quote:
记忆数据存储在 `data/memories.json` 文件中，格式：
{
  "id": "mem_xxx",
  "content": "用户姓名是小明",
  "created_at": "2026-02-28T10:30:00",
  "updated_at": "2026-02-28T10:30:00",
  "source": "builtin_extraction"
}
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Write path in builtin mode is model-driven: the model emits structured tags for add, update, or delete; the proxy parses and applies them.
ledger.quote:
模型在回复末尾添加记忆标签，代理自动解析：
**新增**：`- [日期]记忆内容`
**更新**：`- [日期][UPDATE:编号]新内容`
**删除**：`- [日期][DELETE:编号]`
ledger.locator: README.md, 记忆模式详解 > 内置模式 (builtin)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Write path in external mode is periodic summarization: a separate model runs every N conversation turns to extract and write memories.
ledger.quote: 每隔 N 轮对话，使用独立模型总结对话并生成记忆操作。适用于不支持复杂指令的模型。
ledger.locator: README.md, 记忆模式详解 > 外接模型模式 (external)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Retrieve policy: full mode injects all memories into system prompt; RAG mode selects relevant memories up to rag_max_memories (default 10).
ledger.quote:
**全量注入 (full)**：将所有记忆注入到系统提示词中
**RAG 注入 (rag)**：智能筛选与当前对话相关的记忆
rag_max_memories | RAG 模式最大记忆数 | 10
ledger.locator: README.md, 功能特性 > 多种注入方式; 配置说明 > memory_settings.json
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Forget is supported via explicit DELETE API and via model-issued DELETE tags in builtin mode; no mention of automatic expiry or hide-at-retrieve.
ledger.quote:
`DELETE /memories/{memory_id}` - 删除记忆
**删除**：`- [日期][DELETE:编号]`
ledger.locator: README.md, API 接口 > 记忆管理接口; 记忆模式详解 > 内置模式 (builtin)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: In full injection mode, accumulating too many memories increases token consumption; user is advised to periodically clean up.
ledger.quote: 全量注入模式下，记忆过多会增加 token 消耗，建议定期清理
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: This file is a thin HTTP adapter that forwards a pre-built message list to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; it performs no persist, retrieve, update, or delete operations on any memory store.

ledger.claim: RAG injection mode selects a relevant subset of memories per request rather than always injecting all of them; 'full' mode always injects all memories
